remake = a new version of an earlier film
biopic = a film that tells the life story of a real person
period drama = a film or series set in a historical period, with period clothes
close-up = a shot that shows a face or object in great detail
voice-over = speech heard on the soundtrack while someone else is shown
dubbing = replacing the original speech in a film with another language
subtitles = words on the screen that translate or transcribe the speech
cameo = a brief appearance by a well-known person in a film
typecast = repeatedly given the same kind of acting role
cult film = a film with a small but very devoted group of fans
independent film = a film made outside the major studios, often on a low budget
stunt double = a performer who does dangerous scenes in place of an actor
supporting role = an important acting part that is not the lead
leading role = the main acting part in a film or play
feature film = a full-length film, usually over about ninety minutes
short film = a film lasting only a few minutes to about forty minutes
thriller = a film or book meant to keep you tense and excited
genre = a category of art with shared features, such as comedy or horror
film critic = a person who writes professional reviews of films
age rating = an official label showing the minimum age for a film
